Title: Azure Site Recovery available in five new regions

Body.Content:
Azure Site Recovery continues to grow at scale around the globe. It's now available in Canada Central, Canada East, UK South, UK West, and West US2.

With this expansion, customers in these new regions can enjoy the same reliability and performance levels as set forth in the Site Recovery SLA.

To learn more about Site Recovery, see Getting started with Azure Site Recovery. For more information about the regional availability of the service, visit the Azure regions page.
